subject: Technical deep dive — latency/throughput SLOs for Acme integration
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-10T15:05:00-07:00
Subject: Technical deep dive — latency/throughput SLOs for Acme integration

Hi Jordan —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our call so we have alignment on pain, goals, and next steps: 

Pain points you shared:
- Customer-facing search and chat experiences showing 500–800ms p95 latency today when running the in-house model; spikes during peak traffic that cause timeouts.
- High cost per request when scaling to handle peak QPS (bursty traffic for promotions).
- Need strict data isolation and audit trails for PII-sensitive product flows.

Business goals / success criteria:
- Target p95 inference latency <= 300ms for 512-token prompts for the primary retrieval+rerank path.
- Sustained throughput of ~120 QPS for peak storefront events with graceful degradation below target SLA.
- Cost target: reduce unit inference cost by ~30% vs current infra or show a clear migration path to get there.
- Compliance: SOC2 controls, customer-managed KMS for keys, audit logs retained 1 year.

Technical requirements you mentioned:
- Preference for a ~7B–13B model family, ideally supporting 4-bit quantized variants for efficiency.
- KV-cache support for long conversational sessions and streaming token outputs for UX.
- VPC-private deployment option (dedicated) for data residency.

Next steps I committed to:
1) Loop in Marissa (solutions eng) for an SLO/architecture proposal and sample perf numbers for a 13B quantized model.
2) Share a short SLO matrix and proposed deployment topology (dedicated VPC with autoscaling + burst).
3) Schedule a follow-up technical deep-dive next week to review measurements and a migration plan.

Proposed follow-up times: Tue 4/13 10–11am PT or Wed 4/14 2–3pm PT — does either work?

Thanks — I’ll attach a brief SLO template and network diagram after Marissa chimes in.

Best,
Aditya Rao

Jordan — looping in some more technical detail per our conversation and the goals Aditya summarized. Below is a short SLO matrix, target topology, and model notes. I attached a fillable SLO spreadsheet and a proposed network diagram.

SLOs (suggested baseline for pilot)
- Model-only p95 latency target: <= 200ms for 256-token generation (quantized 13B, dedicated GPU pool with optimized kernels)
- End-to-end p95 (retrieval + generation): <= 300ms for 512 tokens (depends on retrieval latency)
- Throughput: baseline 120 QPS sustained, autoscaling to support bursts to 250 QPS (target cold-start recovery < 60s)
- Error budget: < 0.5% 5xxs per week during pilot

Model & infra recommendations
- Model family: 7B/13B family with option for 4-bit quantized weights (we can validate accuracy delta on your eval set).
- Runtime: Redwood Dedicated with VPC peering to your infra for session affinity + audit log streaming to your SIEM.
- GPU config: A mix of dedicated A10/A100-style instances depending on peak; continuous batching + KV cache for long sessions to reduce per-token cost.
- Fallbacks: Can route lower-cost model variant during capacity constraints; automatic degradation policy to preserve availability.

Deployment topology (attached diagram)
- Ingress via private VPC endpoints -> load balancer -> dedicated GPU pool (pinned pods per customer) -> KMS-integrated key store for encryption at rest.
- Optional edge caching and CDN for static content and precomputed responses.

Data / compliance notes
- SOC2-ready controls; we can enable customer-managed KMS (bring-your-own-key).
- Audit logs include token-level cost / latency traces and can be exported to your logging pipeline.

Attachments (stubs):
- 20270411-SLO-matrix.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet, 47KB)
- 20270411-network-diagram.png (image/png, 120KB)

Action items / next steps:
1) Aditya: confirm Tue 4/13 10am PT and send calendar invite.
2) Jordan: share 1–2 representative prompt sets and a sample evaluation dataset (p95 targets will be validated against these).
3) Marissa: run an initial inference-perf estimate for 13B quantized on target QPS and share expected p95 numbers and cost per 1k tokens.

I’ll follow up with the perf estimate before our call. Happy to adjust targets based on your eval set.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
